question: The twelve built-in titles now visibly come in, each its own way, on moving backgrounds. Do they look produced?
context: Reel: queue/audits/2026-10-12-title-set-<name>.mp4 and .gif for every built-in, contact sheet queue/audits/2026-10-12-title-set-contact.png (0, 100, 200, 300, 400, 600, 800 ms and holding, over a dark and a light recording). Building did not wait on this.

options.label: Keep all twelve as they are
options.summary: Every built-in keeps the entrance and moving background in the reel: words rise, sharpen, slide out of a mask, swing, type, track, fly, fall from large, flip, wipe and settle in, each on its own look.
pros: Twelve clearly different entrances, each measured to be visibly moving half way through
Every title page stands on a moving look
cons: Some titles take well over a second before the whole headline is up
options.mitigation: Energy Punchy on the title makes every in and out about a third quicker.

options.label: Keep them, but calm Keynote Clean's specks and Tech Terminal's grid
options.summary: Same entrances; Keynote Clean's drifting specks of light and Tech Terminal's green grid are made fainter so the words lead.
pros: The two busiest backgrounds stop competing with the words
cons: Those two read a little more like slides again
options.mitigation: Strength is one knob under the Background row, so either can be turned back up per title.

options.label: Keep them, but every entrance a third quicker by default
options.summary: The same twelve entrances, but they land at what Punchy energy gives today: headlines up in well under a second.
cons: Half way through an in, more of the words are already there, so the move reads less
options.mitigation: Calm and Normal stay in the Energy row for anyone who wants the slower build.

options.label: Rework Light Leak and Gradient Glow, keep the other ten
options.summary: Ten stay as filmed. Light Leak's warm look and Gradient Glow's aurora behind its coloured words go back for another pass.
pros: Targets the two pages whose backgrounds are the most assertive
cons: Another round before those two settle
options.mitigation: Say what feels off in a reaction on the audit line and it becomes the brief.
